proofs.text: Run init at `passed` on a python fixture and verify the config, the pytest plugin copy and `conftest.py` exist with no workflow; on a typescript fixture verify the vitest plugin copy and `vitest.config.ts`; on an xunit fixture verify the logger copy and the two wiring lines in the summary. Then run a marketplace copy's own script against a fresh project and verify `.purlin/config.json` exists, `.purlin/plugin-root` holds the install path, and no other file in the project names it

rule_text: Each language init supports is wired the same way in a real project, and an install from the marketplace leaves `.purlin/plugin-root` as the only file naming the install

tests.name: each language wired, and the marketplace install
